pull_requests.title: Splice a hole's ETL4 datasets by depth
pull_requests.author: nhuannguyen87
pull_requests.head: ec8a0b70ee948002dfbd22e311930619ec0b73ac
pull_requests.body:
Holes like 15EIS001 have several ETL4 datasets (main, _wedge, _wedge2, ...). \`context()\` in \`frontend/lib/api.js\` used only the largest one; it now keeps all of them in the order \`/v1/boreholes/{id}/datasets\` returns and uses each from its own start depth until the next one starts, as TeamMemberA and Contributor2 suggested. Mineral log, anomalies, trays, core photos and spectra all follow the splice.

\`next build\` passes; not yet run against live ETL4 data.

pull_requests.title: Fastapi backend integration
pull_requests.author: TeamMemberAaus
pull_requests.head: 76227db847cca03e224c1511f56b80385540a1e8
pull_requests.body:
Task 3 FastAPI integration branch.

Includes:

- FastAPI backend connected to the fixed ETL4/PostGIS handoff
- AWS Aurora PostgreSQL/PostGIS support with IAM authentication
- Private S3 access for spectra, Parquet data, and image assets
- Live AWS validation completed
- Anomaly interval API integrated from Task 2 outputs
- 24 passing backend tests
- Existing Django prototype preserved under `backend-django-old/`
- Frontend API handoff at `backend/docs/FRONTEND_API.md`
- Frontend code has not been modified

Validated release:

`fd02659c-dc3d-52ea-a8eb-c032b91e7624`

New anomaly endpoint:

`GET /v1/datasets/{revision_id}/anomalies`

Still pending:

- Frontend integration by Task 4
- Confidence-level integration once available
